summary.text: Liz Hakola, a Working Class Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Michigan's 1st District to Jack Bergman.
She advanced from the party's convention on June 6, 2026, and was also a general-election candidate for the district in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Hakola as a general-election candidate for Michigan's 1st District in 2022 and 2024. In 2024 she ran on the Working Class Party line and received 1.8% of the vote (8,497 votes).
She received 0.6% of the vote to Jack Bergman's 53.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
